answer.question: How to apply for internship at Icanio Tech School?
answer.answer: To apply for internship tracks at Icanio Tech School, fill in the short form with your name, college, phone, email and preferred internship. Our team calls you within one working day. The counsellor helps you choose a track, a duration from 15 days to six months and a mode. You then complete onboarding and start with a mentor.

sections.heading: Who can apply for internship tracks at Icanio
sections.intro: Our internships are open to a wide range of learners. What matters most is your willingness to learn and to do the work.

items.title: College students in any year
items.body: Students of B.E., B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, MCA, B.Com, BBA, MBA and arts programs can apply. Most interns are in their pre-final or final year, but first and second-year students join shorter tracks too.

items.title: Recent graduates and freshers
items.body: If you have finished your degree and want real project experience before job hunting, a longer internship gives you a portfolio and interview practice.

items.title: Career switchers
items.body: Moving into tech or business roles from another field? Our tracks give you team experience, a mentor and structured learning, even without a matching degree.

items.title: Self-taught learners
items.body: If you have learned from online courses but never worked in a team, an internship shows you how real projects run, with code reviews and deadlines.

sections.heading: What to prepare when you apply for internship
sections.intro: The form itself asks only for basic details. These items help on the counselling call and at onboarding. None of them is a barrier if you do not have it yet.
items: Your resume, if you have one. If not, our team helps you build one during the internship
Your college ID, or proof of your current or most recent course
A laptop with a stable internet connection if you choose online mode
Links to your GitHub, portfolio, designs or past projects, if you have any
Your preferred start date, duration and whether you want weekday or weekend batches
A short note on your goal: a job, a college requirement or exploring a new field

items.title: Track counselling
items.body: If you are unsure between two tracks, the counsellor explains what each one involves and which suits your skills and interests.

items.title: Duration and mode counselling

items.title: Onboarding
items.body: You receive your batch details, meet your mentor and get set up with the tools and accounts your track needs.

items.title: Start learning and building
items.body: You begin the learning phases, then move onto a live project brief. Weekly reviews keep you on track until your certificate.

sections.heading: How to make your application stand out
paragraphs: You do not need a perfect resume to apply for internship tracks with us. What helps most is a clear goal. Tell us whether you want a job after graduation, need an internship for college credit or want to explore a new field. That helps our team suggest the right track and duration.

If you have built anything, share it. A small GitHub project, a Figma file, a blog or a college mini project all tell us how you think. If you have nothing yet, that is fine. Most of our interns build their first real project with us.
Be honest about your time. If you have exams or classes, choose part-time or weekend batches. We recommend picking a pace you can keep, because steady weekly progress matters more than speed.
bullets: State your goal clearly in the message box
Share any links to past work, however small
Pick a start date that avoids your exam weeks
Answer the counselling call, it is where we plan your internship

sections.heading: What you get when you join Icanio Tech School
paragraphs: Icanio Tech School is the education arm of Icanio Technologies, a Tamil Nadu based AI company trusted by 100+ businesses and headquartered in Tirunelveli. When you apply for internship tracks here, you learn from practising engineers with 3+ years of client delivery experience.

Every intern gets 1:1 mentorship, weekly reviews and a live project brief drawn from Icanio client scenarios. You finish with a certificate, a portfolio, resume support and mock interviews. Top performers are referred to the Icanio talent team.

So far, 2,000+ students have trained with us and 1,000+ have been placed, 90% of them within five months. Jeyaram R, for example, joined Icanio Technologies as an SDE after completing Icanio Tech School.

faqs.q: Is there a fee to apply for internship tracks?
faqs.a: No. There is no fee to apply for internship tracks or to talk to a counsellor. Filling in the form simply starts a conversation. Our team explains everything about your chosen track, duration and mode on the call, so you can decide with full information.

faqs.q: How soon will I hear back after I apply?
faqs.a: Our team calls you within one working day of receiving your form. If you miss the call, we will try again, or you can reach us by phone or email. Keep your phone nearby after you apply for internship so the process moves quickly.

faqs.q: Which details does the application form ask for?
faqs.a: The form asks for your name, college name, phone number, email address and the internship you are interested in. There is also an optional message box. Use it to share your goal, preferred start date or links to past work.

faqs.q: Can I apply if I am not sure which track to choose?
faqs.a: Yes. Many students apply for internship without a fixed choice. Pick the closest track on the form and mention that you are unsure. On the counselling call, our team asks about your interests and skills, then suggests one or two tracks that suit you.

faqs.q: Can first-year students apply for internship tracks?
faqs.a: Yes. Students in any year can apply. First and second-year students often start with a 15 day or one month internship to explore a field. Pre-final and final-year students usually choose three or six months for a full live project.

faqs.q: Do I need a resume or a portfolio to apply?
faqs.a: No. A resume or portfolio helps, but it is not required. If you have GitHub links, designs or college projects, add them in the message box. If you do not have a resume yet, our team helps you build one during the internship.

faqs.q: When can I start after I apply for internship?
faqs.a: Start dates are available every month. After the counselling call and onboarding, most students start within a few weeks. You can choose a date that avoids your exams, and weekday or weekend batches that fit your college schedule.

faqs.q: Can a group from my college apply for internship together?
faqs.a: Yes. Classmates can apply for internship tracks together, and colleges can place whole groups of students with us. Each student fills in the form, and you can mention your group in the message box. For MoU partner colleges, our team shares progress updates with the placement cell. Ask your college placement officer, or contact us to apply for internship as a batch.

faqs.q: Will I get a certificate at the end?
faqs.a: Yes. Every intern who completes the program receives an Icanio Tech School certificate stating the track and duration. You also leave with a portfolio, resume support and mock interview practice, and top performers are referred to the Icanio talent team.

takeaways: You can apply for internship tracks at Icanio Tech School with a two minute form and no fee.
Students in any year, graduates, career switchers and self-taught learners are all eligible.
Our team calls within one working day for track, duration and mode counselling, then onboarding.
Durations run from 15 days to six months, offline, online, part time or hybrid.
Prepare a resume if you have one, your college ID, a laptop for online mode and any project links.
conclusion: The hardest part of starting an internship is often just sending the first message. Once you apply for internship tracks with us, our team takes it from there, helping you choose well and start with confidence.
You do not need to have everything figured out. Fill in the form, answer our call and we will plan the rest together. Your first real project could start within a few weeks.
